source_text: Sit still, you monster!

structure.raw_value: HnMaAgNo1>.Sit still, you monster!
structure.script_literal: "HnMaAgNo1>.Sit still, you monster!"

translation: Siedź spokojnie, potworze!

source_text: Hannah!

structure.raw_value: HeShAgNo1.Hannah!
structure.script_literal: "HeShAgNo1.Hannah!"

translation: Hannah!

source_text: Don’t worry, Hannah! I’ll save you!

structure.raw_value: McWoOp.Don’t worry, Hannah! I’ll save you!
structure.script_literal: "McWoOp.Don’t worry, Hannah! I’ll save you!"

translation: Nie martw się, Hannah! Uratuję cię!

source_text: It sucks that my gator pet got away, but at least we got to have fun!

structure.raw_value: HnFrEx.It sucks that my gator pet got away, but at least we got to have fun!
structure.script_literal: "HnFrEx.It sucks that my gator pet got away, but at least we got to have fun!"

translation: Szkoda, że mój aligator zwiał, ale przynajmniej mieliśmy frajdę!

source_text: And that’s all it is… fun.

structure.raw_value: HeFlOp^.And that’s all it is… fun.
structure.script_literal: "HeFlOp^.And that’s all it is… fun."

translation: I tylko tyle to jest… zabawa.

source_text: That was wild.

structure.raw_value: McHaOp.That was wild.
structure.script_literal: "McHaOp.That was wild."

translation: To było szalone.

source_text: Miss Heather sure is fun to play with.

structure.raw_value: HnHaOp.Miss Heather sure is fun to play with.
structure.script_literal: "HnHaOp.Miss Heather sure is fun to play with."

translation: Panna Heather to niezła zabawa.

source_text: I’m glad we could enjoy each other’s company… Maybe we should do it again sometime.

structure.raw_value: HeFlOp^.I’m glad we could enjoy each other’s company… Maybe we should do it again sometime.
structure.script_literal: "HeFlOp^.I’m glad we could enjoy each other’s company… Maybe we should do it again sometime."

translation: Cieszę się, że mogliśmy nacieszyć się sobą… Może powinniśmy to kiedyś powtórzyć.

source_text: Come on! Let’s get back to the church. I gotta find my clothes.

structure.raw_value: HnFrEx.Come on! Let’s get back to the church. I gotta find my clothes.
structure.script_literal: "HnFrEx.Come on! Let’s get back to the church. I gotta find my clothes."

translation: Chodź! Wracajmy do kościoła. Muszę znaleźć ubrania.

source_text: Does she plan on running around the cathedral naked?

structure.raw_value: McWoOp.Does she plan on running around the cathedral naked?
structure.script_literal: "McWoOp.Does she plan on running around the cathedral naked?"

translation: Czy ona zamierza biegać nago po katedrze?

source_text: Let them enjoy the view.

structure.raw_value: HeFlEx.Let them enjoy the view.
structure.script_literal: "HeFlEx.Let them enjoy the view."

translation: Niech nacieszą oczy.

source_text: Damn, Heather. What’s gotten into you?… You seem… naughtier.

structure.raw_value: McFlOp.Damn, Heather. What’s gotten into you?… You seem… naughtier.
structure.script_literal: "McFlOp.Damn, Heather. What’s gotten into you?… You seem… naughtier."

translation: Cholera, Heather. Co w ciebie wstąpiło?… Wydajesz się… niegrzeczniejsza.

source_text: Hey… If Carol can have fun with Chloe, why can’t I enjoy Hannah?

structure.raw_value: HeFlEx.Hey… If Carol can have fun with Chloe, why can’t I enjoy Hannah?
structure.script_literal: "HeFlEx.Hey… If Carol can have fun with Chloe, why can’t I enjoy Hannah?"

translation: Hej… Skoro Carol może bawić się z Chloe, czemu ja nie mogę nacieszyć się Hannah?

source_text: Seems fair to me…

structure.raw_value: McFrOp.Seems fair to me…
structure.script_literal: "McFrOp.Seems fair to me…"

translation: Brzmi fair dla mnie…

source_text: But what about Chloe?

structure.raw_value: McWoOp.But what about Chloe?
structure.script_literal: "McWoOp.But what about Chloe?"

translation: A co z Chloe?

source_text: She’s in it for the excitement… I can see that now.

structure.raw_value: HeFlEx.She’s in it for the excitement… I can see that now.
structure.script_literal: "HeFlEx.She’s in it for the excitement… I can see that now."

translation: Ona jest w tym dla ekscytacji… Teraz to widzę.

source_text: What does it mean for us?

structure.raw_value: McWoOp.What does it mean for us?
structure.script_literal: "McWoOp.What does it mean for us?"

translation: Co to znaczy dla nas?

source_text: Chloe is young and she wants to fool around…

structure.raw_value: HeFlEx.Chloe is young and she wants to fool around…
structure.script_literal: "HeFlEx.Chloe is young and she wants to fool around…"

translation: Chloe jest młoda i chce się pobawić…

source_text: I don’t think she’s looking for love.

structure.raw_value: HeFrDe.I don’t think she’s looking for love.
structure.script_literal: "HeFrDe.I don’t think she’s looking for love."

translation: Nie sądzę, by szukała miłości.

source_text: Do you think?

structure.raw_value: McBaOp.Do you think?
structure.script_literal: "McBaOp.Do you think?"

translation: Myślisz?

source_text: I was her age… If she’s involving Carol, then she’s not being serious.

structure.raw_value: HeFlEx.I was her age… If she’s involving Carol, then she’s not being serious.
structure.script_literal: "HeFlEx.I was her age… If she’s involving Carol, then she’s not being serious."

translation: Byłam w jej wieku… Jeśli angażuje Carol, to nie podchodzi do tego poważnie.

source_text: 1Hero… If you want to have more fun, how about giving me a call from time to time?

structure.raw_value: HeFlEx.1Hero… If you want to have more fun, how about giving me a call from time to time?
structure.script_literal: "HeFlEx.1Hero… If you want to have more fun, how about giving me a call from time to time?"

translation: 1Hero… Jeśli chcesz więcej zabawy, może zadzwonisz do mnie od czasu do czasu?

source_text: So… We’re doing this?

structure.raw_value: McFrOp.So… We’re doing this?
structure.script_literal: "McFrOp.So… We’re doing this?"

translation: Więc… Robimy to?

source_text: I’m learning from Carol… Don’t be so dramatic.

structure.raw_value: HeFlEx.I’m learning from Carol… Don’t be so dramatic.
structure.script_literal: "HeFlEx.I’m learning from Carol… Don’t be so dramatic."

translation: Uczę się od Carol… Nie dramatyzuj.

source_text: Come on. Let’s go before Hannah gets into more trouble.

structure.raw_value: HeFlOp.Come on. Let’s go before Hannah gets into more trouble.
structure.script_literal: "HeFlOp.Come on. Let’s go before Hannah gets into more trouble."

translation: Chodź. Lecimy, zanim Hannah wpadnie w kolejne kłopoty.

source_text: Look! She’s trapped!

structure.raw_value: HnWoEx.Look! She’s trapped!
structure.script_literal: "HnWoEx.Look! She’s trapped!"

translation: Patrz! Jest uwięziona!

source_text: I can’t swim! Especially with a big lizard that wants to eat me!

structure.raw_value: AlWoCl>.I can’t swim! Especially with a big lizard that wants to eat me!
structure.script_literal: "AlWoCl>.I can’t swim! Especially with a big lizard that wants to eat me!"

translation: Nie umiem pływać! Zwłaszcza z wielką jaszczurką, która chce mnie zeżreć!

source_text: Try it now! 1Hero is here!

structure.raw_value: HnHaEx.Try it now! 1Hero is here!
structure.script_literal: "HnHaEx.Try it now! 1Hero is here!"

translation: Spróbuj teraz! 1Hero tu jest!

source_text: What!? No! Don’t swim!

structure.raw_value: McWoCl.What!? No! Don’t swim!
structure.script_literal: "McWoCl.What!? No! Don’t swim!"

translation: Co!? Nie! Nie pływaj!

source_text: Okay! I’m still not swimming.

structure.raw_value: AlWoCl>.Okay! I’m still not swimming.
structure.script_literal: "AlWoCl>.Okay! I’m still not swimming."

translation: Dobra! Wciąż nie pływam.

source_text: What do we do, 1Hero? Tasha will never be my friend if we get Alia killed!

structure.raw_value: HnWoEx.What do we do, 1Hero? Tasha will never be my friend if we get Alia killed!
structure.script_literal: "HnWoEx.What do we do, 1Hero? Tasha will never be my friend if we get Alia killed!"

translation: Co robimy, 1Hero? Tasha nigdy nie będzie moją przyjaciółką, jeśli Alia zginie!

source_text: We have to distract the alligator.

structure.raw_value: McWoEx.We have to distract the alligator.
structure.script_literal: "McWoEx.We have to distract the alligator."

translation: Musimy odwrócić uwagę aligatora.

source_text: I can tie it up. But not in deep water. I’d be dead as a doorknob!

structure.raw_value: HnWoEx.I can tie it up. But not in deep water. I’d be dead as a doorknob!
structure.script_literal: "HnWoEx.I can tie it up. But not in deep water. I’d be dead as a doorknob!"

translation: Mogę go związać. Ale nie w głębokiej wodzie. Byłabym martwa jak kłoda!

source_text: So that’s why you bought the bondage equipment.

structure.raw_value: McAnOp.So that’s why you bought the bondage equipment.
structure.script_literal: "McAnOp.So that’s why you bought the bondage equipment."

translation: Więc dlatego kupiłaś sprzęt do wiązania.

source_text: I know what I’m doing! Just lure the gator under me!

structure.raw_value: HnAnEx.I know what I’m doing! Just lure the gator under me!
structure.script_literal: "HnAnEx.I know what I’m doing! Just lure the gator under me!"

translation: Wiem, co robię! Po prostu zwiń aligatora pode mnie!

source_text: Hannah! You can’t jump from there! You’ll get hurt!

structure.raw_value: McWoCl.Hannah! You can’t jump from there! You’ll get hurt!
structure.script_literal: "McWoCl.Hannah! You can’t jump from there! You’ll get hurt!"

translation: Hannah! Nie możesz stamtąd skakać! Zrobisz sobie krzywdę!

source_text: I know what I’m doing! Trust me!

structure.raw_value: HnAnEx.I know what I’m doing! Trust me!
structure.script_literal: "HnAnEx.I know what I’m doing! Trust me!"

translation: Wiem, co robię! Zaufaj mi!

source_text: How am I going to get that alligator’s attention?

structure.raw_value: McWoOp.How am I going to get that alligator’s attention?
structure.script_literal: "McWoOp.How am I going to get that alligator’s attention?"

translation: Jak mam zwrócić uwagę tego aligatora?

source_text: Look for bait, 1Hero!

structure.raw_value: HnWoEx.Look for bait, 1Hero!
structure.script_literal: "HnWoEx.Look for bait, 1Hero!"

translation: Poszukaj przynęty, 1Hero!

source_text: Don’t worry, Hannah. I have an idea.

structure.raw_value: McFrEx.Don’t worry, Hannah. I have an idea.
structure.script_literal: "McFrEx.Don’t worry, Hannah. I have an idea."

translation: Nie martw się, Hannah. Mam pomysł.

source_text: Swim for safety, Alia! I got the gator!

structure.raw_value: HnWoEx.Swim for safety, Alia! I got the gator!
structure.script_literal: "HnWoEx.Swim for safety, Alia! I got the gator!"

translation: Płyń w bezpieczne miejsce, Alio! Mam aligatora!

source_text: Someone save me!

structure.raw_value: AlWoCl!c>.Someone save me!
structure.script_literal: "AlWoCl!c>.Someone save me!"

translation: Niech ktoś mnie uratuje!

source_text: I almost got him!

structure.raw_value: HnHuAg.I almost got him!
structure.script_literal: "HnHuAg.I almost got him!"

translation: Prawie go mam!

source_text: Hannah!?

structure.raw_value: McShClNo1.Hannah!?
structure.script_literal: "McShClNo1.Hannah!?"

translation: Hannah!?

source_text: Save me!

structure.raw_value: AlWoAg!c>.Save me!
structure.script_literal: "AlWoAg!c>.Save me!"

translation: Ratunku!

source_text: Don’t worry, girl! I got ya!

structure.raw_value: HnWoOp.Don’t worry, girl! I got ya!
structure.script_literal: "HnWoOp.Don’t worry, girl! I got ya!"

translation: Nie martw się, dziewczyno! Mam cię!

source_text: That thing looks worn out.

structure.raw_value: McWoOp.That thing looks worn out.
structure.script_literal: "McWoOp.That thing looks worn out."

translation: To coś wygląda na wykończone.

source_text: I did a number on him, that’s for sure.

structure.raw_value: HnFlEx.I did a number on him, that’s for sure.
structure.script_literal: "HnFlEx.I did a number on him, that’s for sure."

translation: Dałam mu niezły łomot, to pewne.

source_text: I can’t believe you wrestled that thing!

structure.raw_value: AlShOp.I can’t believe you wrestled that thing!
structure.script_literal: "AlShOp.I can’t believe you wrestled that thing!"

translation: Nie mogę uwierzyć, że walczyłaś z tym bydlakiem!

source_text: I told y'all I could handle it.

structure.raw_value: HnFlEx.I told y'all I could handle it.
structure.script_literal: "HnFlEx.I told y'all I could handle it."

translation: Mówiłam wam, że dam radę.

source_text: What are you going to do with it? It will cost a fortune to feed it.

structure.raw_value: McWoEx.What are you going to do with it? It will cost a fortune to feed it.
structure.script_literal: "McWoEx.What are you going to do with it? It will cost a fortune to feed it."

translation: Co z nim zrobisz? Będzie kosztować fortunę, by go wykarmić.

source_text: I’m a farm girl. If anyone can handle it, it’s me.

structure.raw_value: HnFlEx.I’m a farm girl. If anyone can handle it, it’s me.
structure.script_literal: "HnFlEx.I’m a farm girl. If anyone can handle it, it’s me."

translation: Jestem dziewczyną z farmy. Jeśli ktoś da radę, to ja.

source_text: Well… Ask your mother.

structure.raw_value: McBaDe.Well… Ask your mother.
structure.script_literal: "McBaDe.Well… Ask your mother."

translation: Cóż… Zapytaj matkę.

source_text: Yes, daddy.

structure.raw_value: HnFlDe.Yes, daddy.
structure.script_literal: "HnFlDe.Yes, daddy."

translation: Tak, tatusiu.

source_text: Stop calling me that!

structure.raw_value: McAnOp.Stop calling me that!
structure.script_literal: "McAnOp.Stop calling me that!"

translation: Przestań tak do mnie mówić!

source_text: Can we go now? I don’t know how much more adventure I can take.

structure.raw_value: AlWoEx.Can we go now? I don’t know how much more adventure I can take.
structure.script_literal: "AlWoEx.Can we go now? I don’t know how much more adventure I can take."

translation: Możemy już iść? Nie wiem, ile jeszcze przygód zniosę.

source_text: She’s… different.

structure.raw_value: AlWoCl.She’s… different.
structure.script_literal: "AlWoCl.She’s… different."

translation: Ona jest… inna.

source_text: You get used to it.

structure.raw_value: McFlEx.You get used to it.
structure.script_literal: "McFlEx.You get used to it."

translation: Przyzwyczaisz się.
